name: Rasan Information Technology Company
note: Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul 8313, Main Market) after its June 2024 IPO (MENAbytes, 2024-06-22: listed on Tadawul on June 13, 2024; ~30% of shares offered). Operates Tameeni (online insurance aggregator), AwalMazad and Treza (Rasan's own site). MENAbytes named Saudi VC Impact46 the largest shareholder around the IPO; MarketScreener lists the free float at 87.49%. No state shareholder is documented.
